summary: Project-local Claude Code configuration: a pre-tool-use hook that gates force-push operations with an opt-in escape hatch, and a workflow script that runs an adversarial View↔Edit parity audit across all PortableDoc block types.

intentions.title: Guard against unsafe git operations while preserving rebase workflows
intentions.evidence: on-pre-tool-use.sh blocks bare --force push unconditionally but allows --force-with-lease when DOEY_ALLOW_FORCE_PUSH=1 is set; falls through to upstream doey hook for all other rules

intentions.title: Enforce View↔Edit visual parity for PortableDoc rendering
intentions.evidence: view-edit-parity.workflow.js enumerates all block types from render.ex, extracts inline styles and editor CSS from root.html.heex, diffs every block×variant pair, adversarially verifies findings with two independent agent voters, and writes a parity matrix report

intentions.title: Systematise quality audits via reproducible multi-agent workflows
intentions.evidence: The workflow uses paperflow agent types (paperflow-researcher, paperflow-doc-writer), structured JSON schemas per phase, parallel fan-out, and a 2-voter adversarial gate — establishing a repeatable audit pattern rather than a one-off script
